name: Lake Tschida - Sled Creek Campground (Grant County)
note: Five Lake Tschida sites in a shaded row on the Sled Creek arm beside a boat ramp and parking, with a restroom up the access road; a cabin lease area is next door. Sites are short gravel spurs with a table and fire ring, no length posted. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: laketschida.org/sled-creek (BOR/JJDA map: sites 1-5, restroom, parking, boat access) + sled-creek-primitive booking page and Peek program VZWO selling single nights; photos show gravel spurs -> real drive-in campground. Separate from Koehlers Point (~1.25 km) and Schatz's Point (~1.9 km). Operator Lake Tschida Recreation (Tri-Cities Joint Job Development Authority, the managing partner with the Bureau of Reclamation; same operator and ownership as 6025 Rimrock), laketschida.org read 2026-11-12. 'Camping unit' covers motor homes and pull-type campers (campground rules). Horse rule passes: the Hidden Shelter page says it is 'the only campground at Lake Tschida that will accommodate horses' and it is a separate area. Long-stay test 4: every site is sold by the night on Peek; the private cabin and trailer permittee areas are separate lease areas, not campground sites. Public (local): no price gate or presence rule.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-12: the official map puts sites 1-5 on the north shore of the Sled Creek cove beside the ramp; the operator's Peek photos show the water just past each table; Esri World Imagery (z18 at 46.60756,-101.89508) shows the row under its own tree clump with ~10-15 m of open grass to the cove shore, the cove open to the main lake. Dam ~6.6 km E.
fees_source: https://laketschida.org/camping-fees ('$14 nightly fee for a primitive campsite at all campsites'; '$24 nightly fee for electrical campsites.'), read 2026-11-12

sites.note: Primitive 1-5 on short gravel spurs; no length posted.

sites_source: https://laketschida.org/sled-creek-primitive (SLED CREEK PRIMITIVE CAMPSITE 1-5), the Sled Creek map and Peek photos, read 2026-11-12

booking.note: Online booking closes 7 days out; inside a week, book by phone with the office. Friday or Saturday arrivals must take two nights between Memorial Day and Labor Day weekends. Unreserved sites are first come, first served with envelopes at the self-registration kiosks (cash or check).

booking_source: https://laketschida.org/campground-information ('7 DAY RULE ... If you want to make a reservation less than 7 days in advance you must call the office'; 'the minimum of 2 NIGHTS is required between Memorial Day weekend and Labor Day weekend'; 'No campsite may be occupied for more than 14 consecutive days out of 30 consecutive days'); https://laketschida.org/camping-fees ('camping envelopes are provided at self-registration Kiosks ... First Come First Serve'); https://laketschida.org/general-information ('all unreserved sites are available on a first come first serve basis'); the area's Peek booking program; read 2026-11-12
flags: Spur length unknown; the photos show short gravel spurs. Kept under the unclear-pad rule.
Hidden Shelter's horse riding area 'extends from Hidden Shelter to the far west of Sled Creek Campground Area' (operator); the horse camp itself is ~1.6 km E and Sled Creek has no horse facilities.
No season is published for any Lake Tschida area.
curation_note: ND lead 9 (2026-11-12): spur length unposted; horse riding area reaches past Sled Creek but no horse camping here. --Claude
